basic_details.short_information: Bharathiar University, Coimbatore is inviting applications for the post of Programme Co-ordinator, NSS, on a three-year tenure. The post is open to candidates who have served as a Programme Officer (NSS) for at least three years, and the age limit is 50 years. Eight copies of the application must reach the Registrar by 5.30 p.m. on 30 November 2026.

application_fee.details: These amounts include the registration fee. Pay by Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Registrar, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore.

content_sections.heading: About Bharathiar University
content_sections.text: Bharathiar University is a State University in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Its letterhead states that it is accredited with an A++ grade (3.63 CGPA) by NAAC and ranked 46th among Indian universities by MoE-NIRF.

content_sections.heading: Bharathiar University NSS Programme Co-ordinator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Not more than 50 years of age at the time of selection as Programme Co-ordinator. Qualifications and experience, as printed in the notice: Associate Professor / Senior Assistant Professor in the University or Affiliated College. Principal of an Affiliated College, of the status of Associate Professor, with NSS background. Must have been a Programme Officer (NSS) for at least three years. Must have undergone NSS orientation in a Training and Orientation Centre (TOC) / Training, Orientation & Research Centre (TORC). Language: Knowledge of Tamil to the extent of carrying out official correspondence and drafting reports. Marks and relaxations: SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of 5%, from 55% to 50% of the marks at the Master's level. Ph.D. degree holders who passed their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991 get a relaxation of 5%, from 55% to 50% of the marks. Where the grading system is followed, Grade 'B' on the seven-point scale with UGC letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E and F is regarded as equivalent to 55%. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: These amounts include the registration fee. Pay by Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Registrar, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of filled-in application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection follows the norms of the NSS Manual, and applicants must be prepared to attend an interview at their own cost. Anyone who attempts to canvass or influence their candidature will be disqualified. The notice says transparency procedure will be followed as per Government Letter No.7582/K2/2021-1, dated 09.06.2021.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is three years. The selected candidate must join duty immediately and enter into an agreement with the University, in accordance with its laws, on joining the post. Pay protection in any manner is not guaranteed for candidates already in service. The Syndicate reserves the right to fill or not to fill up the post without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bharathiar University NSS Programme Co-ordinator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download or photocopy the application form. Self-designed formats will not be entertained. Fill in the application in all respects, along with the Information Sheet that must accompany each application. Attach the Demand Draft for the fee. Enclose copies of the documents listed below, with supporting evidence for all information given in the form. Prepare eight copies and address them to the Registrar (by designation only), Bharathiar University, Coimbatore – 641 046. Candidates in service must apply through proper channel. If there is a delay, they may send seven advance copies to the Registrar, but their application will be considered only if it is forwarded through proper channel and received in time. Documents and particulars to send: Proof of age with an attested copy of the first page of the SSLC Book Qualifications and degrees, with year or years of passing and the University Other academic distinctions and publications, if any Present occupation and salary with scale of pay Languages known, with copies of recent testimonials Names of two persons to whom a reference can be made

faq.question: Q1. How many copies of the application are required?
faq.answer: Eight copies must be submitted to the Registrar, and the Information Sheet must be filled in and submitted with each application.

faq.question: Q2. Can I type my own application format?
faq.answer: No. Use a downloaded or photocopied application form, because self-designed formats will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What happens if my application arrives after 30 November 2026?
faq.answer: It will be summarily rejected, and the University is not responsible for delays caused by a public holiday, a strike or any other unforeseen reason.

faq.question: Q4. When do I need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: The certificate, obtained from the Appropriate Authority or Management, must be produced at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is the application fee refundable?
faq.answer: No. The application fee, including the registration fee, is non-refundable under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q6. Can I call the University to ask about my application?
faq.answer: No. Enquiries made by telephone or in person will not be entertained.
